title: Chris Ballard: Indications are Charvarius Ward wants to keep playing

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Chris Ballard: Indications are Charvarius Ward wants to keep playing
sources.description: Colts cornerback Charvarius Ward suffered three concussions during the 2025 season and he said last month that the repeated head injuries led to thoughts about whether he will continue playing.
